$comment: Single declarative definition of the status projection's filter vocabulary and named views. Read by src/lib/status.ts and scripts/tree-status.mjs; neither hardcodes a view or a filter.

sources.inventory: session_v2 in the OpenCode SQLite database, paged newest-first and capped (default 2000, --all to ignore).
sources.live: Host endpoints /api/session/active (running ids) and /api/sessions/status (per-session status + pending[sid].forms). The host is the only cross-project source of pending forms.
sources.notARecord: Optional fields are omitted when unset. An absent field means null, never "unknown".

operators.$any: Disjunction inside a view's filter set: a non-empty array of sub-filter sets; the session matches when ANY sub-set matches. Every other key in a filter set is conjoined. Used by needs-restart to combine the outcome arm with the orphan arm.

fields.lastActivity: max(time_updated, time_idle) as epoch milliseconds; null when both are absent.
fields.depth: Distance from the tree root; a root is 0.
fields.id: Session id, used only as a stable tiebreak.

isRoot.description: True when the session has no parent row.

hasParent.description: True when the session has a parent row.

parentId.description: Direct parent session id, when one exists.

rootId.derived: walk parent_id to the top of the chain
rootId.description: Id of the tree root this session belongs to. Self for a root.

depth.derived: number of parent hops to the root
depth.description: A number matches exactly; an object matches an inclusive range.

inTree.description: True when the session participates in a tree at all, rather than standing alone.

isSubtreeOf.derived: anchor === id || anchor is an ancestor of id
isSubtreeOf.description: Self-inclusive: a session belongs to its own subtree. Backs the subtree:<id> view.

isLeaf.description: True when no session names this session as its parent, checked against the whole session table rather than only the capped page.

status.derived: live running set, else host sessions[sid].status, else DB time_idle / idle_outcome
status.description: Run state. running means a turn is in flight or the session holds the execution claim; a paused session still reports running. idle means the session has completed a turn. unknown means neither source carries evidence. archived is a separate filter and is not folded into status.

hasPendingForm.derived: pending[sid].forms is non-empty on the host
hasPendingForm.description: True only when the host reports at least one pending form for the session. Requires the live source; DB-only projections report it as false and set meta.stale, because absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.

claimed.description: Holds an execution claim. SessionStore.claim sets time_suspended when a turn starts, so a paused session reports claimed even though its status is running. claimed true with status idle is a claim left behind by a turn that is no longer live — the orphan case that core never auto-resumes (see F-36). See `orphaned` for the derived form needs-restart's orphan arm uses.

orphaned.derived: claimed ∧ ¬running, where running means the session appears in the host's GET /api/session/active set
orphaned.description: True when a row holds an execution claim but the host does not list it as active — an orphaned claim that core never auto-resumes. false when the row holds no claim (knowable from the database alone) or the host lists the session. null when the row is claimed but the host was not read: unknown is never reported as false, and the projection sets meta.stale plus an orphan-detection warning instead of listing zero. Requires the live source.

project.description: Project id the session belongs to.

lastActivity.type: epoch-ms | ISO-8601 | { after?: value, before?: value }
lastActivity.description: A single value is an inclusive lower bound; an object bounds the range with inclusive after and exclusive before.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome recorded by the engine. Required by needs-restart, which must not invent a failure state for sessions that recorded none. "none" matches a null idle_outcome.

fork.description: True when the session was forked from another session. Required by the default view's documented proxy.

scheduled.description: True only when the metadata explicitly marks the session scheduled. An absent metadata object is not scheduled; nothing is inferred from titles or timing. Required by the default view's documented proxy.

userSpawned.reason: No source exists. session_v2 has no spawn-provenance column (checked all 36 columns), metadata is null for every row in the live database, and neither /api/session/active nor /api/sessions/status reports who created a session. Any boolean would be a guess, so the field is absent from every projected session and the projection reports it under meta.unavailable.

waveIndex.reason: No source exists. Wave or batch membership is not recorded on session_v2 or by the host; only parent links, creation order and depth are observable. depth answers "how deep", not "which wave", so the field is absent and reported under meta.unavailable.

default.proxyNote: Documented proxy: root ∧ ¬fork ∧ metadata.openchamber.kind ≠ 'scheduled'. Upstream exposes no user-spawned flag, so this triple is the closest available approximation of "a conversation the user started". A session with no metadata counts as not scheduled, which widens the view rather than hiding rows; a scheduled session that was never labelled is indistinguishable from a user one.

needs-restart.note: Restart candidates are non-archived sessions that either recorded a failed or interrupted outcome, or hold an orphaned claim (claimed but absent from the host's active set). A session with no recorded idle_outcome is never listed through the outcome arm: absence of an outcome is not a failure. When the host is unreachable the orphan arm cannot be evaluated — orphaned is unknown, meta.stale is true, and the projection warns that orphan detection is unavailable rather than reporting zero.

question-paused.note: Both filters are required. A paused session reports running and holds the execution claim, so status alone cannot find it. A pending form whose turn has ended (form present, idle_outcome succeeded) does not qualify: it is a stale form, not a pause.

tree.note: Every session in one tree, including the root itself. Selected with --root <id>.

subtree.note: One session and everything beneath it. Selected with --subtree <id>.
